title: DNF width from decision tree depth
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer and let $f:\{−1,1\}^n\to\{−1,1\}$ be a Boolean function. If $d$ is the least depth of a decision tree on $\mathbb{F}_2^n$ computing the coordinatewise binary encoding of $f$, then $f$ has a disjunctive normal form in which every term contains at most $d$ literals.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a sign-valued Boolean function on $\{−1,1\}^n$
